results.title: Home lists the Block 1 core workouts and Train lists conditioning, athletic and mobility; starting Giant A from Home opens it
Giant A: exercise order, default exercises, set counts and final-set methods match the baseline effective prescription (7 slots)
Giant B rotation cycle 0: order, exercises, sets and final-set methods match the baseline effective prescription (8 slots)
Giant B rotation cycle 1: order, exercises, sets and final-set methods match the baseline effective prescription (8 slots)
Giant B rotation cycle 2: order, exercises, sets and final-set methods match the baseline effective prescription (8 slots)
Every one of the 29 templates opens without page errors and renders content
Changing a movement from the dropdown persists to the session and survives a reload and resume
Warm-up and cool-down content is shown around the Giant A exercises
Logging a straight set through the UI writes one correctly shaped history record, marks it done and starts the rest timer
Invalid entries are refused with a message and write nothing (no reps, zero reps, negative weight, non-numeric)
Tapping a logged set again removes its record (undo), and logging again after edit stores the new values
A bodyweight movement can be logged with a blank weight (stored as null)
Every straight set of an entire Giant A can be logged through the UI; one record per set, unique ids, correct set numbers
Myo-Reps: activation + mini-set logged and saved as ONE structured record with efforts, totals and volume
Myo-Reps with only an activation effort is refused with guidance and nothing is stored
Myo-Reps with a gap between efforts is refused
ADD MINI-SET adds an effort row and the count survives a reload/resume
DC Rest-Pause needs all 3 efforts: 2 efforts refused, 3 efforts saved as one structured record
Rest-Pause (Giant B rotation group 1, Vertical Pull) saves a 3-effort structured record
FST-7 (Giant B-Upper Lateral Raise): all 7 sets required; a partial block is refused; the full block saves
Lengthened Partials (2 stages) and Mechanical Drop Set (3 stages) save structured records in Giant B-Upper
Widowmaker (Giant B rotation group 2, Leg Press) logs one set record in Widowmaker mode
BFR can be chosen from the intensifier selector and requires all 4 sets
Cluster Sets (Giant A Horizontal Row) store the cluster split note and strength method on the record
Heavy primer (Giant A press) is stored in the strength history, separate from work sets
Loaded stretch hold: needs a positive time; a valid hold is stored in the stretch history
Activator (Giant B first slot): logged to the activator history, not to work-set history
Conditioning cardio entry saves one cardio record for the session
Interrupted mid-workout: logged sets, typed-but-unlogged values and the chosen exercise all come back after a reload, in the SAME session (no duplicate)
EXIT keeps the draft; starting the same template again resumes it instead of creating another
Two different drafts (A and B) coexist; each resumes with its own data
An interrupted Myo-Reps block keeps its typed efforts and effort check marks across a reload
The rest timer end time is saved with the draft and resumes after a reload
Session is autosaved on every input (no explicit save): typed values reach storage immediately
Finishing with nothing logged is refused and the session stays a draft
Finishing a workout marks it complete with finish time, set count, recovery and notes; the draft banner and current-session pointer are gone
A completed session is not resumable: starting the same template afterwards creates a new draft
History records carry the session id, template, block, set number, final-set flag and a valid timestamp; ids are unique
After finishing A, B and Athletic through the UI, Training Budget and Coach Handoff count each exactly once with the corrected categories
Progress page set count and "Recent performance" reflect the logged work after a reload
A finished session, its records and the Home state survive refresh and reopen
RECORDED vs NOT RECORDED is visible while training: a logged set shows a check mark, an unlogged set shows an open circle

FIXED IN PHASE 2 (labels only): a workout finished with ONE logged set out of ~20 still counts as one completed session and one budget exposure, but Coach Handoff and the Finish notice now label it Partial
KNOWN GAP (narrowed in Phase 2): there is still no per-session history view; skipped work is labelled only in the Finish notice and Coach Handoff, not on Progress, Home or the After-action page
INCOMPLETE is visible only as a draft: an unfinished workout is listed under "Unfinished workouts" with RESUME, never as a completed session

Export after a real workflow (finished session + draft with a saved Myo block + typed value) restores in a clean profile with every stored value identical (draft updatedAt aside), and the draft resumes with its inputs
Malformed or hostile imports (16 cases) are rejected, the restore button never appears, and storage and the draft are unchanged afterwards (draft updatedAt aside)
A tampered file changed after preview is re-validated at restore time and refused with storage unchanged
Cardio text with comparison signs ("<10:00") is saved, the app's own export validates and restores it, and HTML-like text ("<b>") is refused at logging (fix of the Phase 1 defect D1)
When browser storage is full, logging a set shows a clear message, writes no partial record, does not mark the set done, and works again once space is freed
If saving the finished session fails, the workout stays an unfinished draft with its records intact, and finishing succeeds after space is freed
A restore that cannot fit in storage is refused with a plain message and leaves every byte of existing data (including the draft) unchanged
The service worker installs, takes control after a reload, and caches the shell under the integration cache name
Offline: the app reloads from cache, a workout can be started, a set logged, saved and finished with the network disabled

Cache update path: an installed OLD version shows an update prompt when the new version is deployed, does NOT replace itself mid-workout, keeps the draft, and after the tap runs the new code under the new cache name with the old cache deleted
Every file the service worker pre-caches exists on the server and the cached index.html is the served one (no stale shell)
